title: Kannimala Estate Weather Log 2023
description: Daily observations from three automatic weather stations on a hill tea estate, for every day of 2023. The estate's yearly summary built on this export can't be trusted. Find out why.

columns.station: categorical, one of three estate weather stations
columns.rain_mm: float, rainfall in the 24 hours to 08:30, millimetres
columns.temp_max_c: float, daily maximum air temperature, Celsius
columns.temp_min_c: float, daily minimum air temperature, Celsius
